challenge.results: The broad Visual Basic family wording is consistent with the narrower VBA wording and does not identify a numbered edition. The longer scripting-edition name and Windows feature lifecycle concern the scripting technology without equating it with the VB6 language or IDE.

limitations: The review covers the documented language relationship. The named Microsoft script engine and the Windows feature are separately scoped product identities.
